constructorProof.opening: Force existing diagnostic singleton initialization immediately before the sole app scene constructor call; its existing opening event precedes constructor marker. No new timer, observable state, body logging or polling.
constructorProof.identity: Unique diagnosticLifecycleToken plus scene/root/camera identities and modelSHA256. ObjectIdentifier alone may be reused.
constructorProof.meaning: A completed constructor is not proof of active renderer, attachment, retained host or lifetime.
requiredEvidence: Complete process stream from opening/first sequence through normal terminal observation; no sequence gaps or truncation
Exactly one constructor event for each unique scene lifecycle token; every later scene token must have a preceding constructor marker
Suppressed arm exactly one unique constructor, linked to the actual workout scene and canonical Evo model SHA
Any unexplained additional or non-Evo constructor invalidates the history-free gate; do not discard it
Unsuppressed control records actual predecessor/workout construction, without assuming a fixed constructor count

runtimeGates: Same binary and faithful normal route in both arms
Train placeholder measured actual layout and surrounding controls; intended aspect ratio is not sufficient evidence
Actual workout board viewport/frame/camera and phase/selection semantics match; no compensating frames
Full natural active/rest/next-active captures and CPU brackets; retain all failures
No old hand-suppression or unrelated diagnostic flags inherited
limits: Lexical removal of this Train BoardMap plus complete observed constructor stream supports absence of a constructed predecessor board scene in that launch, not absence of every possible retained renderer object.
